items.explanation: boya + t (causative) + ıl (passive): someone ordered it, someone painted it, both off camera.

options: The guests waited half an hour on their own
The guests were kept waiting for half an hour
items.explanation: bekle + t + il: the guests were made to wait. Who ordered it — off camera.
öl — to die, öldür — to kill, öldürül — to be killed.

exercises.instruction: Which passive goes after the causative?

items.explanation: The causative ends in t or r, so the passive is always -Il. The vowel follows the stem's last vowel.

exercises.instruction: Add the layers: causative and passive.

items.translation: The car was washed yesterday (at a car wash).
items.explanation: First the causative -t, then the passive -ıl: yıkatıldı.

items.translation: The guests were introduced to each other.
items.explanation: tanış + tır + ıl: someone introduced the guests.

items.translation: The guests were kept waiting for half an hour.
items.explanation: bekle + t + il. -n won't work here: after the causative it's only -Il.

items.translation: The king was killed in the palace.
items.explanation: öl → öldür (to kill) → öldürül (to be killed).
tarafından needs a passive: tanıştırıldık.

items.translation: The office was painted over the weekend (on order).
items.explanation: Causative first, then passive: boya-t-ıl-dı.

items.translation: Old friends were brought back together years later.
items.explanation: buluş + tur + ul: someone brought them together. buluştu — they met on their own.

options: The wall was painted on someone's orders
items.explanation: Causative -t + passive -ıl: there was someone who ordered it and someone who did it, neither one named.

items.statement: When voices combine, the passive comes after the causative: tanış-tır-ıl.
items.explanation: The order: stem, reciprocal, causative, passive, tense.

items.prompt: How do you say “I got a haircut at the barber's”?
items.explanation: You're the one who ordered it: active causative kestirdim. kestim — you cut your own hair.
Someone brought us together: tanış + tır + ıl + dık. Tanıştık — we met on our own, tanıştırdık — we introduced someone.

items.statement: After the causative the passive can be -n: yıkatndı.
items.explanation: The causative ends in t or r, and after them it's only -Il: yıkatıldı.
